name: cetner-confirm
description: Re-check of the riven-credible-ga-1 finalist built on Wojciech Cetner's list (Convergence IV 1st), which led the confirmation by +5.6 points [-7.3, +18.6] with net_128, now with the current bot (net_164: beats net_128 57%). Same credible jury as the GA (Riven mirror, Orianna, Evelynn: the matchups where simulated rates agree with real players), 300 games per opponent per list, seats swapped, new seed. Cetner's own list is played too, to see what the GA's changes add. Verdict: the finalist against the Sacramento base, the difference of weighted rates with its 95% interval.
